objects.name: VAPOR PANDA Uses AI-Driven ARTEX to Scale a Global Espionage Campaign
objects.description: Cyber incidents create both technical and legal challenges, making coordination between DFIR teams and experienced legal counsel essential. This article explores why organizations should establish these relationships before an incident occurs and how a coordinated response can improve forensic investigations, regulatory preparedness, communications, recovery, and overall cyber resilience.
